framework: Distributed network reliability / error-correcting redundancy under a fixed local overlap-capacity budget.

minimum_graph_feature_computation_plan: For each candidate material row, first assign material_id, structure_id, snapshot_id, family/batch, and label_provenance_id; rows without these keys remain blocked.
Before reading any external labels, lock OI_formula_source, OI_ref_value, fixed-density or fixed-pair normalization, graph_cutoff_rule, laplacian_convention, rho_convention, and attack_matching_rule.
Compute B0_OI_norm and nuisance controls from structure/provenance only; audit carrier density and mobility-edge controls for target leakage.
Build A_w with w_ij=max(0,OI_ij/OI_ref), A_w symmetric, A_w diagonal zero, and fixed edge cutoff.

Compute G1_lambda2_Lsym from the symmetric normalized weighted Laplacian, G1_rho_A_budget_norm from spectral_radius(A_w/S_w), and G1_attack_gap_lambda2 from high-betweenness damage minus matched random damage.
Join only external labels that pass provenance and forbidden-control audit; then test held-out residual power after B0_OI_norm plus controls with family/batch blocking.

layer_1.LP29_mapping: OI_norm is total local edge budget; lambda_2 and attack_gap test whether that budget is globally redundant or bottlenecked.
layer_1.round3_status: Still a computable hypothesis only; no material row has enough provenance.

layer_2.LP29_mapping: Equal overlap budgets can have different cut vulnerabilities; high-betweenness attack loss is the operational check.

a_objection: All G1_* metrics are still functions of an OI-derived A_w, so they may be nonlinear reparameterizations of Srivastava-style orbital overlap.
b_response: Accepted. B-positive synthetic only proves the residualization pipeline can detect a planted graph signal and reject a null-control shape. It does not establish any material conclusion until G1_* features add held-out residual power on provenance-complete external labels after OI_norm plus controls.
next_plan: Stop expanding protocol prose. Unblock one real or semi-real row family by acquiring structure files and external label provenance, then run the same residual protocol on material-validation-eligible rows only.
